scope: Supplementary, development-only search for a real 9 mm structural sample after the 6/7/8/9 mm goal matrix produced 6/7/8/10. Not a replacement trial, new classifier, independent confirmation or vision endpoint run.
method: Native flat ruler and original 640x480 ECM optics. Run exactly three fresh full truth-controlled trajectories with 3 mm advance cap and collector goals 8.25, 8.5, 8.75 mm; actual separated rows are scored without rounding the requested goal to a label. Each collection goal is below the benchmark's 9 mm stop; the safety cap in that individual collection never exceeds the original 10 mm. Keep the frozen optical reader. Report all outcomes, including any cases that do not produce 9 mm. Do not use the reserved 2.5/1.5/1 mm confirmation trajectories.
